title: The Five Worlds of Darkness and the King Who Rules Them
description: A complete anatomy of self-love. Five worlds gushed from the Land of Darkness, each with five archons, five spirits, five bodies, five trees molded, five creatures, articulated through their kings, metals (gold, lead, bronze, iron, silver), and tastes — the negative mirror of the Five Storehouses of divine reception. The composite King of Darkness has lion-head, eagle-shoulders, dragon-belly, fish-tail; his vast outward power is exposed as a confined sense-perception that knows only what stands before its face.
